h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rajkot

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Rajkot

c: Rajkot is one of Saurashtra's main industrial cities, with a large base of engineering units, growing residential societies and well-used public gardens. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment here for societies, schools, factory campuses and gardens run by the Rajkot Municipal Corporation. We build the full Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 390 km away, and bring it to Rajkot by road.

Because Rajkot is fairly close to our factory, many buyers here plan a full set of stations in one go. A society clubhouse lawn might take five or six machines, while a factory campus may want a compact corner near the canteen for shift workers. Tell us who will use the gym and when, and we will build the layout around that. Our team or a dealer in Gujarat installs it.

items.q: Can you set up an outdoor gym inside an industrial campus in Rajkot?
items.a: Yes. Share the open area available and the number of people likely to use it at one time. We will suggest machines that fit and mark the clear space around each one.

items.q: Is a combination machine better than two separate ones?
items.a: A combination frame saves space and needs one foundation instead of two. Separate machines let two people work at once. On a small plot, combinations usually make more sense.

items.q: How is the equipment brought to Rajkot?
items.a: We manufacture it at our Vasai factory, pack it and dispatch it by road. Our installation team or a local dealer then fixes it on your site.
